mapper.insert: insert into product_comment(order_id, order_no, product_id, user_id, rating, content, merchant_reply, append_content, create_time, update_time, reply_time, append_time) values (#{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{productId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{merchantReply}, #{appendContent}, now(), now(), #{replyTime}, #{appendTime})
mapper.select: select id,order_id,order_no,product_id,user_id,rating,content, merchant_reply,create_time,update_time,reply_time from product_comment where product_id = #{productId} order by create_time desc
mapper.update: update product_comment set merchant_reply = #{merchantReply}, reply_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update product_comment set append_content = #{appendContent}, append_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id}
